# A slice reached through a field (x.f, x.f.g) is vectorized when the loop only stores
# elements and assigns locals, with no call: nothing in the body can change the slice
# header the field holds, so the emitted code copies it into a local once, inside a
# check that the loop runs at all, and the original loop runs on the overlap fallback.
# A nil pointer with no iterations must not panic, as the scalar loop does not.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

type Vec struct {
	Values []float32
	Other  []float32
	Inner  struct{ Data []float32 }
}

type Ints struct{ N []int32 }

func Scale(v *Vec, a float32) {
	for i := range v.Values {
		v.Values[i] *= a
	}
}

func Add(dst, a *Vec) {
	for i := range dst.Values {
		dst.Values[i] += a.Values[i]
	}
}

func Nested(v *Vec, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		v.Inner.Data[i] = v.Other[i] * 2
	}
}

func Copy(dst, src *Vec) {
	for i := range dst.Values {
		dst.Values[i] = src.Values[i]
	}
}

func SumAll(v Ints) int32 {
	var s int32
	for i := 0; i < len(v.N); i++ {
		s += v.N[i]
	}
	return s
}

func Mixed(dst *Vec, src []float32) {
	for i := range dst.Values {
		dst.Values[i] = src[i] + 1
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

type Vec struct {
	Values []float32
	Other  []float32
	Inner  struct{ Data []float32 }
}

type Ints struct{ N []int32 }

func Scale(v *Vec, a float32) {
	_vcFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(a)
	if len(v.Values) > 0 {
		_sv_Values := v.Values
		for _i := 0; _i < len(v.Values); {
			_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_sv_Values[_i:])
			_v1.Mul(_vcFloat32s0).StorePart(_sv_Values[_i:])
			_i += _n
		}
	}
}

func Add(dst, a *Vec) {
	if len(dst.Values) > 0 {
		_sdst_Values, _sa_Values := dst.Values, a.Values
		if _loopvecOverlap(_sdst_Values, _sa_Values) {
			for i := range dst.Values {
				dst.Values[i] += a.Values[i]
			}
		} else {
			if len(dst.Values) > 0 {
				_ = _sa_Values[len(dst.Values)-1]
				for _i := 0; _i < len(dst.Values); {
					_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_sdst_Values[_i:])
					_v2, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_sa_Values[_i:])
					_v1.Add(_v2).StorePart(_sdst_Values[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func Nested(v *Vec, n int) {
	_vcFloat32s2 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(2)
	if n > 0 {
		_sv_Inner_Data, _sv_Other := v.Inner.Data, v.Other
		if _loopvecOverlap(_sv_Inner_Data, _sv_Other, 0, n, 0, n) {
			for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
				v.Inner.Data[i] = v.Other[i] * 2
			}
		} else {
			if n > 0 {
				_ = _sv_Inner_Data[n-1]
				_ = _sv_Other[n-1]
				for _i := 0; _i < n; {
					_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_sv_Other[_i:n])
					_v1.Mul(_vcFloat32s2).StorePart(_sv_Inner_Data[_i:n])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func Copy(dst, src *Vec) {
	if len(dst.Values) > 0 {
		_sdst_Values, _ssrc_Values := dst.Values, src.Values
		if _loopvecOverlap(_sdst_Values, _ssrc_Values) {
			for i := range dst.Values {
				dst.Values[i] = src.Values[i]
			}
		} else {
			if len(dst.Values) > 0 {
				_ = _ssrc_Values[len(dst.Values)-1]
				copy(_sdst_Values, _ssrc_Values)
			}
		}
	}
}

func SumAll(v Ints) int32 {
	var s int32
	if len(v.N) > 0 {
		_sv_N := v.N
		{
			_i := 0
			if len(v.N) >= 64 {
				_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(0)
				_lanes := _a1.Len()
				for ; _i+_lanes <= len(v.N); _i += _lanes {
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_sv_N[_i:])
					_a1 = _a1.Add(_v1)
				}
				var _buf1 [16]int32
				_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
				for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
					s = s + _x
				}
			}
			for i := _i; i < len(v.N); i++ {
				s += v.N[i]
			}
		}
	}
	return s
}

func Mixed(dst *Vec, src []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s5 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(1)
	if len(dst.Values) > 0 {
		_sdst_Values := dst.Values
		if _loopvecOverlap(_sdst_Values, src) {
			for i := range dst.Values {
				dst.Values[i] = src[i] + 1
			}
		} else {
			if len(dst.Values) > 0 {
				_ = src[len(dst.Values)-1]
				for _i := 0; _i < len(dst.Values); {
					_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(src[_i:])
					_v1.Add(_vcFloat32s5).StorePart(_sdst_Values[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

type Vec struct {
	Values []float32
	Other  []float32
	Inner  struct{ Data []float32 }
}

type Ints struct{ N []int32 }

func Scale(v *Vec, a float32) {
	for i := range v.Values {
		v.Values[i] *= a
	}
}

func Add(dst, a *Vec) {
	for i := range dst.Values {
		dst.Values[i] += a.Values[i]
	}
}

func Nested(v *Vec, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		v.Inner.Data[i] = v.Other[i] * 2
	}
}

func Copy(dst, src *Vec) {
	for i := range dst.Values {
		dst.Values[i] = src.Values[i]
	}
}

func SumAll(v Ints) int32 {
	var s int32
	for i := 0; i < len(v.N); i++ {
		s += v.N[i]
	}
	return s
}

func Mixed(dst *Vec, src []float32) {
	for i := range dst.Values {
		dst.Values[i] = src[i] + 1
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 6 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func try(f func()) (panicked bool) {
	defer func() { panicked = recover() != nil }()
	f()
	return
}

func ramp(n int, scale float32) []float32 {
	s := make([]float32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = float32(i+1) * scale
	}
	return s
}

func sum(s []float32) (t float64) {
	for i, v := range s {
		t += float64(v) * float64(i+1)
	}
	return
}

func vec(n int, scale float32) *test.Vec {
	v := &test.Vec{Values: ramp(n, scale), Other: ramp(n, 2*scale)}
	v.Inner.Data = make([]float32, n)
	return v
}

func main() {
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 5, 16, 17, 100} {
		v := vec(n, 1)
		test.Scale(v, 3)
		fmt.Println(n, "Scale", sum(v.Values))

		d, a := vec(n, 1), vec(n, 5)
		test.Add(d, a)
		fmt.Println(n, "Add", sum(d.Values))

		// The same struct twice is an exact alias.
		test.Add(d, d)
		fmt.Println(n, "AddSelf", sum(d.Values))

		// Two structs over one backing array, offset by one: the original loop runs.
		buf := ramp(n+2, 1)
		x, y := &test.Vec{Values: buf[:n]}, &test.Vec{Values: buf[1 : n+1]}
		test.Add(y, x)
		fmt.Println(n, "AddOverlap", sum(buf))

		w := vec(n, 1)
		test.Nested(w, n)
		fmt.Println(n, "Nested", sum(w.Inner.Data))

		c, s := vec(n, 1), vec(n, 7)
		test.Copy(c, s)
		fmt.Println(n, "Copy", sum(c.Values))

		ints := make([]int32, n)
		for i := range ints {
			ints[i] = int32(i*i + 1)
		}
		fmt.Println(n, "SumAll", test.SumAll(test.Ints{N: ints}))

		m := vec(n, 1)
		test.Mixed(m, ramp(n, 4))
		fmt.Println(n, "Mixed", sum(m.Values))
	}

	// No iterations: a nil pointer is never read.
	fmt.Println("nil", try(func() { test.Nested(nil, 0) }), try(func() { test.Add(&test.Vec{}, nil) }), try(func() { test.Copy(&test.Vec{}, nil) }))
	// Iterations: it is, and it panics as the scalar loop does.
	fmt.Println("nilReads", try(func() { test.Add(vec(3, 1), nil) }), try(func() { test.Nested(nil, 3) }))
	// A short operand panics.
	fmt.Println("short", try(func() { test.Add(vec(8, 1), vec(7, 1)) }), try(func() { test.Mixed(vec(8, 1), ramp(7, 1)) }))
}
